caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a historical dress, predominantly in shades of pink and coral with white highlights and accents. The dress has a fitted bodice, three-quarter-length sleeves with layers of white ruffles at the cuffs, and a full, voluminous skirt that spreads outward. The neckline is round and decorated with a white lace trim. The composition centers the dress on the page, and it is depicted without a head, hands, or feet. To the upper right of the dress, there are several smaller sketches in pencil: a bonnet or cap, three types of decorative trims or ribbons (one labeled "RIBBON TO HAT," another marked "LACE EDGE OR HAT OR NECK"), and a leafy adornment. To the left of the dress, there is a sketched sleeve with a ruffled edge. The drawing and sketches are contained within a faint pinkish border that frames the entire page. The background is a light beige, and the entire image is rendered with soft shading and careful attention to folds and textures.
title: Dutch Dress
